What to know
about our puppies

Documents and vaccinations

Puppies leave for their new homes with their documents. Parasite treatments and vaccinations are given according to age.

Meeting your puppy

We will tell you about your puppy's temperament and introduce the parents. More photos and videos are available on request.

Support after coming home

We can help with feeding, training and care. When needed, we can involve a dog trainer, handler or veterinarian.
